# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas practice for local small businesses. The entry point is a free one-page online checkup: where a shop ranks on Google Maps against the three businesses nearest it, whether AI assistants like ChatGPT recommend that shop or a competitor, and the three issues costing it customers. Nothing about the checkup requires the owner's password. Paid work follows only if the owner wants the problems fixed: $500 one-time, then $49/month. Jack also runs community AI workshops in Dallas–Fort Worth. Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, +1 (469) 425-4142 (text CHECKUP with a shop name to start). Service area: Dallas, Richardson, Plano, Garland, Allen (Texas, USA). Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, +1 (469) 425-4142. Service area: Dallas, Richardson, Plano, Garland, Allen (Texas, USA).

Free, no password or account access needed, delivered within about two days. Started by texting CHECKUP plus the shop name to (469) 425-4142.
- Missed-Call Rescue: when a business misses a call, the caller gets an automatic text with a booking link within ten seconds. $49/month flat, free install, keep your existing number, 30-day money-back.

- AI education: free community talks, workshops, and build events. Paid offering: "AI for Beginner" — a live class taught in person in Dallas and online. No coding required.

## Services

- [Free Online Checkup](https://aimanjack.com/#pricing): the entry point — one free page showing Google Maps position, AI-assistant visibility, and the three issues costing the business customers
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://aimanjack.com/missed-call-text-back/): every missed call texts the customer back in ten seconds; $49/month, free install, 30-day money-back
- [Small Business Website Design](https://aimanjack.com/website/): $500 build, $49/month, live in a week, for Dallas local businesses
- [Salon Website Design](https://aimanjack.com/website/salons/): booking-first websites for hair salons, nail salons, and beauty pros
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://aimanjack.com/ai-workflow/): missed-call textback, review support, and lead follow-up using the tools a business already has
- [AI Consulting & Automation Services](https://aimanjack.com/business-services/): start with one bottleneck, build only what helps
